title: Data and analysis for: Measuring and Attributing Provisioning Delay in Elastic Cloud Slurm Clusters
description: Anonymized timing data and an analysis script for the paper "Measuring and Attributing Provisioning Delay in Elastic Cloud Slurm Clusters: An Empirical Case Study". The data cover 25 Slurm jobs (10 single-node and 10 four-node cold starts, 5 warm starts; 55 job-node timelines) on AWS ParallelCluster 3.16.1 with Slurm 25.11.8 and c7i.large instances in us-west-2a, with eight timeline boundaries per job and node, per-phase statistics, run accounting, controller-log cross-checks, and one complete anonymized trace. The included script analysis/paper_tables.py reproduces the paper's phase statistics. Data: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT.
